Frozen contexts prevent task authority escalation.
An actual-query ledger binds citations to observed records.
Merge validates findings before shared publication.
Replay is confined to results/trace.json paths and checks companion identities.

local_context.page_specific_instructions: The replay path means trace.json files located within results/, not a single literal file results/trace.json. Display this as results/**/trace.json if needed. Private evaluator oracles are for scoring and not runtime evidence. Replay does not execute the graph/tools/provider. No claim of complete security against every attack.

slides.title: Backup: The demonstration can run offline
slides.intent: A simple numbered reproducibility sequence with three short command lines in Arial, not a tiny full installation transcript. Show saved artifacts alongside the replay step.
key_points: Validate data, run Dynamic with Mock, then replay the saved trace.
Outputs: trace.json, result.json and report.md.
The dashboard and CLI use the same saved artifacts.
A real-provider evaluation is separate from an offline Mock demonstration.

local_context.page_specific_instructions: Exact commands: python -m incident_lens.cli validate-data; python -m incident_lens.cli run --case incident_001 --provider mock --variant dynamic --cache-mode off --out results/demo; python -m incident_lens.cli replay --trace results/demo/trace.json. Wrap the run command across readable lines if needed; never invent flags. Small gray note: Start from the documented installed environment; real provider configuration is separate.
